## 5. Memory and data movement {#memory}

**Revisit both the tile storage and its loading path.** CDNA 4 offers more LDS capacity, a different bank count and additional load forms. These are opportunities to retune a kernel, not a prediction that its existing LDS layout will be faster.

Direct loads remove the payload's intermediate VGPR staging. Address registers and other kernel registers still exist. The diagram deliberately omits cache levels and physical wiring. [Global-to-LDS semantics](https://rocm-handbook.amd.com/projects/amd-rocm-optimization-guide/en/latest/compiler-builtins/cross-arch/direct-to-lds-builtins.html).

### Copy size is not destination stride {#lds-addressing}

With the immediate offset set to zero, the reviewed interface places lane `L` at `LDS base + L×stride`: stride is 4 bytes for 1/2/4-byte transfers and 16 bytes for 12/16-byte transfers. Thus a 12-byte transfer writes three DWORDs in a four-DWORD slot. Packing the next lane at `base+12` would describe a different layout. Respect the interface's wave-uniform LDS base, alignment, bounds and target-specific size constraints. [Builtin parameters and destination addressing](https://rocm-handbook.amd.com/projects/amd-rocm-optimization-guide/en/latest/compiler-builtins/cross-arch/direct-to-lds-builtins.html).

For bank reasoning, a useful address-level calculation is `bank = floor(byte_address/4) mod bank_count`. Addresses 0 and 128 therefore name the same bank under 32 banks and different banks under 64 banks. This arithmetic alone does **not** prove a conflict or a speedup: the instruction's access width, simultaneously serviced lanes and broadcast behavior still matter.

### Transpose during an LDS read {#transpose-loads}

The CDNA 4 `ds_read_tr*` builtin family helps transform a suitable LDS tile into matrix operand fragments. Select the element width and pointer pattern together; one load is not a generic transpose of an arbitrary matrix. In particular, `__builtin_amdgcn_ds_read_tr16_b64_v4f16` returns four FP16 values and has a `__fp16`-based pointer signature at the pinned revision. [Clang declaration](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/4e9d349ab86dc0a913db3cba11aa2763d6985aff/clang/include/clang/Basic/BuiltinsAMDGPU.td#L791) · [AMD transpose-load guide](https://rocm-handbook.amd.com/projects/amd-rocm-optimization-guide/en/latest/compiler-builtins/cdna/cdna4-mfma-lds-builtins.html).

Keep this transformation separate from both ordinary `ds_read` and the wider global-to-LDS copy. A pipeline can use one, both or neither, depending on the required layout.
